children: Canada broadband access provider's Q4 fiscal revenue rose 36% yr/yr to a record high
Adjusted EPS for Q4 fiscal 2026 beat analyst expectations
Company raised calendar 2026 revenue growth outlook to 27%-32% yr/yr
Vecima raises calendar 2026 revenue growth outlook to 27%-32% from 22.5%-30%
Company expects fiscal 2027 revenue to grow 30%-35% over fiscal 2026
Vecima anticipates adjusted EBITDA margin of about 20% in calendar 2026 and fiscal 2027
ENTRA DAA PRODUCTS - Record sales and increased shipments of Entra DAA products, including ERM3xx Remote-PHY modules and Entra SF-4X Optical platform, drove Q4 results
VCMTS CLOUD SOLUTION - Progress in trials and commercialization of vCMTS cloud-based DOCSIS core solution, including new Tier 1 customer agreements, contributed to Q4 performance
CONTENT DELIVERY & STORAGE - Double-digit revenue growth in Content Delivery and Storage segment, supported by managed IPTV uptake and targeted Dynamic Ad Insertion deployments
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the communications & networking peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Vecima Networks Inc is C$19.50, about 56% above its September 23 closing price of C$12.50
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
